subject: Features
source_sentence: The system uses the following features: a. Word N-grams (WN): presence or absence of word n-grams from n = 1 to n = 4. Character N-grams (CN): presence or absence of character n-grams from n = 3 to n = 5. Word Embeddings (WE): an average of the word embeddings of all the words in a tweet. We calculate individual word embeddings using the negative sampling skip-gram model implemented in Word2Vec . Word vectors are trained from ten million English tweets taken from the Edinburgh Twitter Corpus . We set Word2Vec parameters: window size: 5; number of dimensions: 400. d. Affect Lexicons (L): we use the lexicons shown in Table 4 by aggregating the information for all the words in a tweet.
